name: Crelate Talent Chrome Extension (Legacy)
description: Uses text from a web page to create a contact record inside of Crelate Talent

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src https://* data: blob: filesystem:; frame-src 'self' https://*.crelatedev.com/ https://*.crelatetest.com/ https://*.crelatepreview.com/ https://*.crelatestaging.com/ https://*.crelate.com/;
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' https://*.crelatedev.com/ https://*.crelatetest.com/ https://*.crelatepreview.com/ https://*.crelatestaging.com/ https://*.crelate.com/ 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; child-src 'self'; connect-src https://* data: blob: filesystem:; frame-src 'self' https://*.crelatedev.com/ https://*.crelatetest.com/ https://*.crelatepreview.com/ https://*.crelatestaging.com/ https://*.crelate.com/;

author: Crelate Development Team
